headings.styles: tracking-tight, font-bold, never center by default

colors.strategy: Archetype 3: Pastel & Soft with E1 Neo-Brutalist Twist (Hard borders + soft pastels). Grounded, approachable, yet highly structured for learning.
rules: Use 2px solid black borders for cards and buttons in light mode. In dark mode, use subtle gray borders (border-neutral-800) but keep vivid button colors.
Avoid default soft shadows. Use hard offset shadows.
Never use full-screen gradients. Keep the reading experience high-contrast and distraction-free.

radii.default: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for main action pills

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid for the main dashboard combined with single focused views for studying.

grid_modes.flashcard_player: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh] max-w-2xl mx-auto w-full

layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding on cards (p-6 or p-8) to avoid text hitting the heavy borders.

motion.flashcard_flip: Use framer-motion. Animate rotateY(180deg) for the card flip. Ensure backface-visibility is hidden.
motion.transitions: transition-transform transition-shadow duration-200 ease-out (Target specific properties, NEVER transition: all)

components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Must have 2px border, solid pastel backgrounds, and a hard shadow.
components_strategy.cards: Background matches theme, solid border, hard shadow. Do not overuse cards; keep lists flat with bottom borders.
components_strategy.upload_zone: Dashed thick border. On drag over: change background to a pastel tint (e.g., #DDD6FE) and scale up icon slightly.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2.2 for a slightly bolder, more graphic feel that matches the neo-brutalist typography.

images.description: Pastel abstract geometric background used for empty states (e.g., no study material uploaded yet) or login backgrounds.
Abstract shapes for decorative dashboard elements or generic topic thumbnails.

media.rules: No placeholder URLs. Always use real UI states or the provided abstract imagery.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Black text on pastel backgrounds is highly legible. In dark mode, ensure text is bright (#FAFAFA) on dark cards.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for flashcard flips (fallback to crossfade).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Neo-Brutalist pastel theme (Archetype 3) for a study tool that feels engaging, structured, and modern.
Do NOT use standard soft box-shadows. Use hard offset shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#171717] in light mode).
Override default Shadcn card and button borders to be thicker (2px) and high contrast.
For the flashcard player, use 'framer-motion' for a smooth 3D flip effect on the Y-axis. Provide 'Mark Known/Unknown' controls.
The Quiz player should present one question at a time or a clearly separated list. Use pastel background highlights for selected answers.
The UI must not have transparent headers. Use solid backgrounds with bottom borders for the navigation.
Use data-testid on all key elements (buttons, inputs, cards, flip triggers) for robust testing.
Install and configure Outfit and Figtree fonts. Ensure headings are tracking-tight and body text is leading-relaxed.
Ensure 'lucide-react' icons are heavily utilized for actions like 'Upload', 'History', 'Flip', 'Next', 'Previous'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through hard shadows and borders, not blurs.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties like transform and box-shadow.
Provide micro-animations for interactions (e.g., hover states shift up and left with increased shadow, active states press down).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
